description: Quarterly inspection: checked coupling alignment, seal leakage and bearing noise. No defects found.
Replaced worn mechanical seal after pressure drop alarm.
Post-repair check: seal dry, discharge pressure recovering. Pump kept under maintenance until the impeller is inspected.
Replaced drive-end bearing after rising vibration readings; regreased the non-drive end.
Calibrated the discharge pressure transmitter against a reference gauge (deviation 0.05 bar, adjusted).
Verified flow meter zero point and span with a portable ultrasonic meter; within tolerance.
Commissioning check after installation: mounting, wiring and enclosure seal verified. Not yet activated.
Cracked pump casing found; repair judged uneconomical. Recommended replacement and decommissioning.
